'''Fostin''' was a black-colored [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least nine [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Fostin Nine]].
